title: THE SKY IS VAST
BUT GOD KNOWS YOU
end: The Praise Garden — enter His gates with thanksgiving
stock_queries: golden twilight sky over calm misty valley
starry night sky over calm mountain lake
misty countryside in soft golden morning light
sunlit forest glade with peaceful light beams
peaceful river flowing through lush countryside at twilight
calm landscape under vast evening sky
golden light over peaceful pine forest

scenes.a: When the evening sky dwarfs your heavy thoughts,
remember that the Maker of every star still knows your name.
As written in Psalm eight verse one, "O LORD, our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth! who hast set thy glory above the heavens."
Heavenly Father, we pause to thank You for the boundless majesty of Your creation.
You set glory above the stars, yet You listen gently to every quiet prayer we breathe.
Anchor our hearts in Your quiet peace, knowing Your light covers every step of our path.
Amen. Peace remains when the evening sky dwarfs your heavy thoughts.
